title: Frozen SWAP 4.3.1 Extended Drainage Exchange Source Inventory

exact_per_level_sequence.water_level_resolution: for SWSRF>=2, secondary levels use WLS and primary levels use WLP
exact_per_level_sequence.ponding_sill_gate: evaluate exchange only if WL<PONDMX OR GWL<PONDMX; otherwise QDRAIN=0
exact_per_level_sequence.dry_control_head_branch: if WL<=ZBOTDR+0.001, DRAINL=ZBOTDR; for open channels WETPER=WIDTHR
exact_per_level_sequence.wet_control_head_branch: if WL>ZBOTDR+0.001, DRAINL=WL; for open channels WETPER=WIDTHR+2*sqrt((WL-ZBOTDR)^2+((WL-ZBOTDR)/TALUDR)^2)
exact_per_level_sequence.infiltration_head_cap: if DIFFL<0 and GWL<GWLINF then DIFFL=GWLINF-DRAINL
exact_per_level_sequence.highest_power_interflow: if highest level and SWNRSRF=2, QDRAIN=COFINTFL*DIFFL**EXPINTFL without sign guard
exact_per_level_sequence.highest_surface_drainage: if highest level, SWNRSRF=1 and DIFFL>0, RD=max(RSURFDEEP-DIFFL,RSURFSHALLOW)

SWSRF1_undefined_value_characterization.source_fact: local WL is assigned only inside IF(SWSRF>=2) but WL is read by the ponding-sill condition for SWSRF=1
SWSRF1_undefined_value_characterization.local_declaration: WL is a local REAL(8) in drainflux_extended
SWSRF1_undefined_value_characterization.consequence: the frozen SWSRF=1 extended route can depend on undefined/stale local WL and cannot be source-equivalently migrated as a deterministic production law without separate disposition

power_interflow_difference_from_basic_Dr.basic_Dramet3: tests DIFFL>=0 before power interflow and routes DIFFL<0 to infiltration
power_interflow_difference_from_basic_Dr.extended: highest SWNRSRF=2 executes the power expression before any sign-specific resistance branch
power_interflow_difference_from_basic_Dr.consequence: F-VQ42 positive-side power-law science is reusable, but negative extended SWNRSRF=2 is not covered and remains held

nonsmooth_and_discontinuous_seams.behavior: strictly above the threshold POND is added to DIFFL; at/below it is not
nonsmooth_and_discontinuous_seams.classification: flux can be discontinuous when POND is nonzero

nonsmooth_and_discontinuous_seams.condition: GWL or WL crosses ZBOTDR+0.001 cm while the other remains at/below
nonsmooth_and_discontinuous_seams.behavior: branch jumps between exact zero and an exchange evaluation whose head difference need not tend to zero
below GWLINF the effective head is GWLINF-DRAINL and has zero GWL derivative; above it the raw head has unit GWL derivative
nonsmooth_and_discontinuous_seams.classification: continuous value under ordinary admissible geometry, derivative kink

nonsmooth_and_discontinuous_seams.condition: DIFFL=RSURFDEEP-RSURFSHALLOW on highest SWNRSRF=1 positive branch
nonsmooth_and_discontinuous_seams.behavior: RD switches from RSURFDEEP-DIFFL to RSURFSHALLOW
source selects infiltration resistance at zero and drainage resistance for positive DIFFL
nonsmooth_and_discontinuous_seams.classification: zero flux is continuous but one-sided slopes generally differ

nonsmooth_and_discontinuous_seams.condition: both WL and GWL reach PONDMX
nonsmooth_and_discontinuous_seams.behavior: source suppresses QDRAIN to zero instead of continuing the constitutive expression

definitions.e: effective DIFFL after ponding and GWLINF cap

smooth_branch_sensitivity_equations.head_derivative_before_cap: de/dGWL=1 away from GWL=-0.1; de/dWL=-d(DRAINL)/dWL; de/dPOND=1 only on GWL>-0.1 branch
smooth_branch_sensitivity_equations.drain_level_derivative: d(DRAINL)/dWL=0 on WL<=ZBOTDR+0.001 branch and 1 on WL>ZBOTDR+0.001 branch
smooth_branch_sensitivity_equations.wet_perimeter_derivative: for open wet branch with depth d=WL-ZBOTDR>0, dP/dWL=2*d*(1+1/TALUDR^2)/sqrt(d^2+(d/TALUDR)^2); otherwise 0
smooth_branch_sensitivity_equations.surface_drainage_RD_derivative: dRD/de=-1 on RSURFDEEP-e>RSURFSHALLOW branch and 0 on the capped shallow-resistance branch; undefined at equality
smooth_branch_sensitivity_equations.power_interflow_derivative: for e>0, dq/dx=COFINTFL*EXPINTFL*e^(EXPINTFL-1)*de/dx; at e=0 use explicit one-sided/singularity metadata per F-VQ42

state_and_mass_classification.legacy_QDRD: secondary-level derived aggregate; separate aggregation/composition concern
state_and_mass_classification.availability_scaling: state-dependent limiter owned by F-PM08D3, excluded from D2 constitutive law

canonical_context_at_activation.consequence: D2 is readiness-only and must not imply a currently admitted extended-exchange production provider
